title.narrative: Operating the dialysis center at Banadir Hospital Mogadishu

description.narrative: In the current phase, the project will aim to provide its services to 280 people per month, including 100 dialysis patients registered in the dialysis center’s records and receiving services ranging between two and three dialysis sessions per week, meaning 850 regular sessions and an average of 50 emergency sessions per month, meaning about 900 dialysis sessions. College per month, thus covering 10,800 patient sessions for the entire duration of the project, 12 months

Providing health care services by providing the necessary treatment in the city of Mogadishu to preserve the lives of patients with kidney disease and kidney failure resulting from the lack of treatment and thus reducing the number of deaths by providing free treatment.

Providing the need to cover the treatment of patients with renal failure and ensuring that they receive the necessary treatment free of charge, with an expected number of 10,800 dialysis sessions and 2,160 medical services in the kidney disease clinic, supporting the steadfastness of the medical and technical staff and reducing the migration of (38) medical and technical staff with the localization of the service.
